title.zh: Senate Republicans Release Revised Clarity Act Ahead of September 15 Vote

current_state.zh: Senate Republicans released a revised Clarity Act that would require non-decentralized DeFi trading protocols to register with the CFTC, ahead of a September 15 procedural vote.
